name: KamLAND
summary: KamLAND used a kilotonne liquid-scintillator detector at Kamioka to establish long-baseline reactor-antineutrino disappearance and map its energy dependence. It also pioneered geoneutrino detection and contributed low-energy solar and astrophysical studies.
detection_principle: Inverse beta decay creates a prompt positron and delayed neutron capture. Large target mass, underground shielding and purification suppress backgrounds. Solar neutrinos are studied through neutrino-electron elastic scattering in separate low-background analyses.
